Dean’s Welcome Address

Уважаемые абитуриенты, студенты, преподаватели, выпускники и гости!Факультет педагогического образования — это современное образовательное пространство, где формируются будущие педагоги, воспитатели, логопеды, психологи и исследователи в области образования. Мы стремимся создавать условия для качественной подготовки специалистов, способных успешно работать в условиях современных образовательных изменений и вносить вклад в развитие общества.Наша главная задача — подготовка высококвалифицированных, конкурентоспособных и востребованных специалистов, обладающих глубокими профессиональными знаниями, педагогическим мастерством, лидерскими качествами и высокой социальной ответственностью.Добро пожаловать на факультет педагогического образования — территорию профессионального роста, творчества и новых возможностей!
History of the Faculty

Факультет педагогического образования был создан на основании решения Ученого совета БГУ имени К. Карасаева и приказа №05-4/80 от 2 декабря 2021 года. Создание факультета стало важным этапом в развитии педагогического образования университета и направлено на подготовку специалистов нового поколения для системы образования Кыргызской Республики.

С момента основания факультет успешно развивается, совершенствует образовательные программы, укрепляет научный потенциал и расширяет сотрудничество с образовательными учреждениями и международными организациями.
The Faculty's mission

Миссия факультета педагогического образования заключается в подготовке профессионально компетентных, творчески мыслящих и социально ответственных педагогов, способных эффективно работать в современных условиях и обеспечивать качественное образование подрастающего поколения.
Структура и образовательная деятельность
Факультет осуществляет подготовку специалистов по направлению «Педагогика» (550700), а также реализует программы бакалавриата, магистратуры, аспирантуры и подготовки PhD-докторов.

Образовательный процесс ориентирован на сочетание фундаментальной теоретической подготовки и практической деятельности. Студенты получают глубокие знания в области педагогики, психологии и современных образовательных технологий, развивают навыки научно-исследовательской работы и профессионального общения.
В состав факультета педагогического образования входят две выпускающие кафедры, обеспечивающие подготовку высококвалифицированных специалистов в сфере образования, психологии и воспитания.
Department of Theory and Methodology of Primary and Preschool Education

Кафедра осуществляет подготовку специалистов для системы дошкольного и начального образования. Основное внимание уделяется изучению современных образовательных технологий, методик обучения и воспитания детей дошкольного и младшего школьного возраста.

Преподаватели кафедры активно занимаются научно-исследовательской деятельностью, внедряют инновационные подходы в образовательный процесс и обеспечивают практико-ориентированную подготовку будущих педагогов.
Department of Pedagogy and Psychology

Кафедра педагогики и психологии является одной из ведущих кафедр факультета, осуществляющей подготовку специалистов в области педагогики, психологии, социальной педагогики, логопедии и психолого-педагогического сопровождения образовательного процесса.

Деятельность кафедры направлена на формирование профессиональных компетенций будущих педагогов и психологов, развитие исследовательских навыков, подготовку специалистов, способных эффективно решать современные образовательные и социально-психологические задачи.
Кафедра активно сотрудничает с образовательными учреждениями, научными организациями и социальными партнерами, обеспечивая высокий уровень практической подготовки студентов.
Студенческая жизнь

Студенческая жизнь на факультете педагогического образования насыщена интересными событиями и возможностями для самореализации. Студенты активно участвуют в научно-практических конференциях, педагогических олимпиадах, конкурсах профессионального мастерства, форумах и образовательных проектах.

Большое внимание уделяется развитию творческого, спортивного и общественного потенциала молодежи. Участие в культурно-массовых мероприятиях, волонтерских программах и студенческих инициативах способствует формированию лидерских качеств, коммуникативных навыков и активной гражданской позиции.
Выпускники факультета

Выпускники факультета педагогического образования успешно работают в общеобразовательных школах, дошкольных образовательных организациях, учреждениях дополнительного образования, научно-методических центрах и образовательных проектах.

Многие продолжают обучение в магистратуре и аспирантуре, занимаются научной деятельностью, реализуют собственные образовательные инициативы и успешно строят профессиональную карьеру как в Кыргызстане, так и за его пределами.
Наши выпускники являются достойными представителями педагогического сообщества и вносят значительный вклад в развитие отечественной системы образования.
Employees

Кадровый потенциал факультета педагогического образования представлен высококвалифицированными преподавателями, учеными и специалистами, обладающими значительным педагогическим, научным и практическим опытом.

Профессорско-преподавательский состав факультета осуществляет подготовку бакалавров, магистров, аспирантов и PhD-докторантов, активно участвует в научно-исследовательской деятельности, разрабатывает современные образовательные программы и внедряет инновационные технологии обучения.

Преподаватели факультета регулярно проходят курсы повышения квалификации, участвуют в международных и республиканских научно-практических конференциях, реализуют научные проекты и публикуют результаты исследований в ведущих научных изданиях.

Сотрудники факультета не только передают студентам профессиональные знания и практические навыки, но и способствуют формированию у будущих педагогов высокой культуры, ответственности, гуманистических ценностей и стремления к непрерывному профессиональному развитию.

Благодаря профессионализму, творческому подходу и преданности своему делу коллектив факультета успешно решает задачи подготовки конкурентоспособных специалистов для системы образования Кыргызской Республики

Formation of competitive, proactive and socially responsible teachers who possess modern teaching and upbringing methods. We include innovative educational technologies and active interaction with practice.

Research activities of the Department of TiMNDO

Research directions. The Department of Theory and Methodology of Primary and Preschool Education focuses on current topics in pedagogical science. Considerable attention is paid to the development and implementation digital educational technologies in working with young children (for example, creating digital trainers and simulators to develop professional skills in future teachers)

Participation in conferences. The department's teachers regularly publish scientific articles and present reports at Russian and international conferences, seminars and webinars. This allows them to professionally exchange experience with colleagues, present the results of their own research and take into account global trends in primary and preschool education. For example, the department takes part in annual pedagogical forums and webinars on early childhood development issues. In addition, the teachers organize their own scientific events - university and inter-university conferences.
Organization of scientific events. The department traditionally hosts large scientific and methodological events that attract teachers and students.
International scientific and practical conference "CURRENT PROBLEMS OF PEDAGOGICAL SCIENCE: STUDENTS' VIEW"

Publication activity. The department's teachers are the authors of a large number of scientific publications. Every year they prepare and publish articles on current issues in the pedagogy of primary and preschool education: these are studies on teaching methods, psychological and pedagogical support for children, development of creative abilities and other key topics. The materials are published in peer-reviewed journals, conference proceedings and electronic publications. Along with articles, the department's staff publish teaching aids and monographs that systematize the theoretical and practical results obtained. In recent years, several author's monographs have been prepared under the guidance of the department's teachers, reflecting advanced experience and new approaches in the pedagogy of primary and preschool education.

Thus, The research work of the Department of Theory and Methodology of Primary and Preschool Education combines fundamental science and practical significance: teachers actively master modern technologies and methods, share their results at specialized conferences and through publications, which strengthens the image of the faculty of pedagogical education and ensures a high level of training for future teachers.
Laboratory "Bashat"

The Faculty of Pedagogical Education has a unique space - Laboratory "Bashat", created by students and teachers of the Department of Theory and Methods of Teaching Primary and Preschool Education. "Bashat" — is a modern play and development center where faculty members can safely and usefully leave their children while studying or working.

Цели и задачиЛаборатория предназначена для раннего развития, социального взаимодействия и эмоциональной поддержки ребёнка. Здесь дети занимаются творчеством, играют в развивающие игры и участвуют в оздоровительных занятиях под руководством опытных педагогов и студентов.

Organization of workPupils of the group "Bashat" are divided into small subgroups, each of which is accompanied by a student mentor. Classes are based on pre-developed programs, including elements of art therapy, musical and rhythmic games, and role-playing learning.
Benefits for the Department and Faculty
Internship for students: future teachers gain real experience working with children of different ages.
Family support: Employees can combine professional and parental responsibilities without stress.
Innovations in education: the laboratory is an experimental platform for testing new methods and programs.
The Bashat Laboratory has become a center of attraction for the staff and students of our faculty, combining science, practice and family care in one bright and warm space.

Thanks to the combination of youth, scientific activity and pedagogical skills, the Department of Theory and Methodology of Teaching Primary and Preschool Education is confidently moving forward, providing high-quality training for future teachers who are able to work effectively in the conditions of the modern educational space!

R&D, NIRSResearch work / Research activities of students

Research works:At the department, research work is an important part of the educational process. These works allow students to connect theoretical knowledge with practical research, forming the skills of research activities. The research work of students is aimed at solving current problems in the field of pedagogy, psychology and social pedagogy, which, in turn, is intended to improve work with children and the educational process.The main goal of research work is to help students master the methods and methodology of independent research, develop skills in analyzing pedagogical and psychological situations. In their research, students study the psychological and pedagogical characteristics of children, their social and emotional development, gaining experience in presenting new proposals in the field of education.In addition, as a result of research work, students form their scientific point of view, learn to analyze empirical data and systematically develop practical and theoretical materials. This process contributes to the future professional activities of students and helps to make a contribution to the scientific field.

Objectives for the development of the department’s research work:The organization of the department's research work (RW) is based on the concept of developing the research activities of the teaching staff and is aimed at improving the quality of graduates at all levels of education. The results of research work and the knowledge obtained in the process of their implementation are used in the development of new courses and programs, as well as in the preparation of textbooks.The faculty of the department conducts scientific research on the most pressing topics of modern education.

Research work of students / Educational and research activities of students:Participation of students in research work is a mandatory element of training future specialists. Research activities of students are an effective tool for improving the quality of training specialists and are closely linked to the educational process.

The main organizational forms of students’ research work at the department:• Conducting classes with elements of scientific research;• Participation in round tables;• Participation of students in scientific conferences;• Participation of students in various events (departmental, faculty, republican) of a scientific and competitive nature.

The main objectives of students' scientific work:• Mastering research methods and methodology;• Formation of a scientific point of view;• Research of pedagogical and psychological problems;• Analysis of empirical data;• Creation and expansion of new knowledge;• Compliance with scientific ethics;• Presentation of scientific results.

The management of scientific research work is carried out by the teachers of the department. For employees of this category, scientific research activity is mandatory and is considered one of the main aspects of their work.
PracticeEducational practice of the Department of Pedagogy and Psychology

The educational practice of the Department of Pedagogy and Psychology provides students with the opportunity to transform theoretical knowledge into practical experience. The main goal of the educational practice is to prepare students for pedagogical and psychological activities, to form their practical skills, to develop the ability to effectively and sustainably manage various situations in the educational process. This practice provides students with the opportunity to acquire the necessary competencies to work in their profession.

Objectives of the practice:• Conducting pedagogical activities;• Conducting psychological activities;• Working with students;• Research activities;• Work in real conditions;• Preparation of the final report and reflection.
Types of practice:Adaptation and pedagogical practice - 5th semester (2 weeks);Professional and profile practice – VII semester (4 weeks).

Historical portrait of the Department of Pedagogy and Psychology

Кафедра педагогики и психологии была основана в 1979 году в Фрунзенском педагогическом институте при факультете «Русский язык и литература». Её возглавил доктор педагогических наук, профессор, корреспондент-член Академии педагогических наук СССР и корреспондент-член Национальной академии наук Кыргызской Республики Мукаш Руставлетович Балтабаев (1979-1982 годы).

Later, the department was headed by candidates of pedagogical sciences, associate professors: Maria Abdykerimova, Mikhail Zhulenkov, Kashkar Dzhumabaev, as well as doctor of pedagogical sciences, professor Ryskeldi Toksonbaev. Currently, the department is headed by candidate of pedagogical sciences, associate professor Mira Alymbekovna Muratalieva.

The department employed prominent scientists, educators and psychologists of Kyrgyzstan, such as Professor, Candidate of Pedagogical Sciences V.M. Grebennikov; Associate Professor, Candidate of Pedagogical Sciences L.I. Kubatieva; Professor, Doctor of Pedagogical Sciences Z.V. Andreeva; Candidate of Pedagogical Sciences, Associate Professor M.G. Zhulenkov; Doctor of Pedagogical Sciences, Professor I.R. Khalitova; Candidate of Pedagogical Sciences, Associate Professor A.A. Mashkevich; Candidate of Pedagogical Sciences, Associate Professor V.A. Nuzhniy; as well as experienced teachers K.T. Tulegenov, A.G. Tynystanova, T.Zh. Zhumagulov and others. In 2009, the Department of Pedagogy and Psychology began its professional educational, scientific, educational and career guidance activities under the auspices of the Faculty of Slavic Studies of the Belarusian State University named after K. Karasayev. Since 2021, the department has been operating on the basis of the Faculty of Pedagogical Education of the Bishkek State University named after K. Karasaev.

The Department of Pedagogy and Psychology includes prominent scientists, educators and psychologists of Kyrgyzstan. Among them are Professor, Candidate of Pedagogical Sciences Grebennikov V.M.; Associate Professor, Candidate of Pedagogical Sciences L.I. Kubatieva; Professor, Doctor of Pedagogical Sciences Andreeva Z.V.; Candidate of Pedagogical Sciences, Associate Professor Zhulenkov M.G.; Doctor of Pedagogical Sciences, Professor Khalitova I.R.; Candidate of Pedagogical Sciences, Associate Professor Mashkevich A.A.; Candidate of Pedagogical Sciences, Associate Professor Nuzhniy V.A.; as well as senior teachers Tulegenov K.T., Tynystanova A.G., Zhumagulov T.Zh. and others.

In 2009, the department carried out its professional training, scientific activities and career guidance work under the auspices of the Faculty of Slavic Studies of the Belarusian State University named after K. Karasaev.
Since 2021, the department has been operating on the basis of the Faculty of Pedagogical Education of the Bishkek State University named after K. Karasaev.

The purpose of the department — development of scientifically based pedagogical and psychological methods in the process of education and upbringing, their application in practice, as well as training of qualified teachers and psychologists.

Основная деятельность кафедры заключается в преподавании педагогики и психологии студентам Бишкека государственного университета, а также в подготовке высококвалифицированных специалистов по психологическим и педагогическим дисциплинам. Кафедра ориентирована на подготовку отличных специалистов в профилях «Социальная педагогика», «Социальная педагогика и психология», «Логопедия», соответствующих требованиям государства в будущем.
Research activities of the department:

Научная тема кафедры: В настоящее время сотрудники кафедры проводят исследование на тему «Педагогические компетенции XXI века: стратегии толерантного обучения и воспитания». Результаты научных исследований представляются на международных научно-практических конференциях, семинарах и тренингах. В этих мероприятиях активно участвуют как молодые исследователи Кыргызстана, так и зарубежные коллеги из Казахстана, Германии и России.

In the period from 2020 to 2024, the department's teachers published 87 articles in various scientific journals and collections of scientific and practical conferences, of which 30 works were published in scientific journals included in the RINS.

Department also trains postgraduate and master's students in the field of pedagogy: general pedagogy, history of pedagogy and education, and social pedagogy. Over the past three years, about 60 postgraduate students have completed their studies at the department, of which 20 defended their candidate dissertations.

На кафедре функционирует центр «Педагогическое мастерство и повышение квалификации работников образования», где проводятся систематические тренинги по психологическим и педагогическим направлениям для учителей, социальных педагогов средних школ, магистрантов и аспирантов в реабилитационных центрах.

One of the most important aspects of professional development is the exchange of experience and development of ideas with colleagues from other universities. The Department of Pedagogy and Psychology pays great attention to international cooperation within the framework of agreements concluded with universities in Russia and Kazakhstan.

At present, the department's partners are: Moscow State Linguistic University, Bashkir State University named after M. Akmulla, Zhezkazgan University named after O.A. Baikonurov, Institute for Advanced Training of Teachers in Moscow, and Kazakh State Pedagogical University for Girls in Almaty.
Such cooperation facilitates the exchange of best practices, the introduction of new educational technologies and methods, and the strengthening of scientific ties between educational institutions.
Competitive advantages of educational programs:

Curricula that meet the requirements of modern education are aimed at designing and effectively organizing an innovative educational process. These programs promote the use of active and interactive forms and methods of teaching, as well as improving the content of education based on individualization of learning.
In addition, they create conditions for the application of modern methods in the training of future teachers. The key areas of these programs are:
Creating individual educational trajectories for students - this allows us to take into account the unique needs and abilities of each student.
Organizational and pedagogical support in the educational process - provides support to students at all stages of their education.
Consulting support - helps students in solving emerging issues and problems related to the educational process.
Social and pedagogical assistance — aimed at supporting students in their social adaptation and development.
These aspects make the curricula more attractive and effective, contributing to the training of highly qualified specialists in the field of pedagogy and psychology.
The main competitive advantages of the curriculum:

High qualification and scientific and pedagogical training of the teaching staff: The department's teachers have significant experience and knowledge in the field of pedagogy and psychology, which ensures high-quality education for students.

Wide opportunities for organizing educational and industrial practices: The curriculum includes theoretical training, which is combined with practical experience in leading schools, gymnasiums and preschool educational institutions in the city of Bishkek.
Characteristics of professional activities of graduates:

The professional activities of graduates cover organizational and pedagogical, educational and upbringing, scientific and methodological and social and pedagogical activities in the field of education. They can work in preschool, primary, basic and senior grades of educational institutions, as well as in organizations of additional education.
The main objects of professional activity are:
Children and adolescents with different age characteristics.
The social environment of these children.
Participants in the educational process (parents, colleagues, administration).
Educational programs and methodological complexes.

Graduates are engaged in organizing the educational process, ensuring the effectiveness of teaching and upbringing, as well as promoting the development of the child in various social and cultural conditions.
Professional activity:
Выпускники по специальности «Социальный педагог и психолог» осуществляют свою профессиональную деятельность в следующих областях:
Social and psychological development of children, adolescents and young people.
Social environment of children and families from different age and social groups.
Determining the social status of vulnerable groups (orphans, children with disabilities, children from low-income families) in educational institutions.
Psychological and pedagogical activities aimed at the social adaptation of students and their families.
Protecting children's rights, identifying crisis situations and implementing preventive measures.
Psychological diagnostics, participation in consultations and development of development programs.
Interaction with participants in the educational process (parents, teachers, administration, public organizations).
Counseling and assistance to children and adolescents with social and psychological difficulties.
Features of the curriculum (for speech therapist, social worker, psychologist):

In the educational process, much attention is paid to scientific research activities. Students master research skills, methods of modeling pedagogical and psychological situations, speech therapy correction activities and methods of assistance based on social pedagogy. They also gain practical experience in providing psychological, pedagogical and social support to children, taking into account their individual characteristics.
The training is focused on practical activities and the development of professional skills in real working conditions.

Crisis centers and orphanages
Private and public speech therapy centers

Organizations implementing multicultural and inclusive education programs.
These aspects make the specialist training program relevant to the modern labor market in the field of education.
